name: Arcturus Ironveil Jammer Cloak
description: The Arcturus Ironveil Jammer Cloak is a wearable signal suppression system built into a heavy-weave tactical coat lined with interlocking metamaterial panels that generate a localized electromagnetic interference field extending approximately three meters from the wearer in all directions. Unlike conventional jammers that broadcast disruptive noise across a spectrum, the Ironveil uses destructive wave interference — generating precise counter-signals that cancel incoming and outgoing transmissions at the wave level, producing a bubble of effective electromagnetic silence without the detectable jamming signature that draws security attention. Within the field, all wireless communication, remote detonation signals, tracking pings, and mesh-relay transmissions are suppressed.

specifications.suppression_method: Active destructive wave interference; no detectable jamming broadcast signature
specifications.spectra_suppressed: RF 300MHz–300GHz; standard mesh relay bands; remote detonation frequencies; GPS and positioning signals
specifications.activation: Tactile pressure switch, left inner cuff
specifications.appearance: Tailored heavy-weave tactical coat; civilian styling, available in four colorways
specifications.detection: Field itself is undetectable on standard sweeps; physical metamaterial lining detectable by advanced materials scan

tactical_use: Operators use the Ironveil to create a communications blackout zone around a target, preventing distress signals, tracking pings, or automated emergency transmissions from escaping during an extraction or termination operation. Security teams walking point through the suppression field are effectively blind to mesh-relay intelligence, which creates tactical windows for ambush. Counter-use involves entering a building or secured area where electronic access systems rely on wireless authentication — the Ironveil renders these systems inoperable, forcing manual override or security escalation that can itself be exploited.
cultural_context: The Ironveil's prohibited status has paradoxically elevated it to a kind of dark prestige item in GLMZ's underworld. Owning one is a statement — it says you operate at a level where silencing a target's communications is a professional necessity rather than an incidental benefit. There is a grim shorthand in certain circles: if someone shows up wearing an Ironveil, the meeting was never meant to end with everyone walking away. Corporate security teams are trained to treat the identification of an active Ironveil field as an immediate lethal-threat escalation.
known_users: Arcturus Defense Solutions extraction and termination contractors
Black-market arms dealers conducting sensitive transactions
Certain district-level crime bosses who wear one as a constant deterrent
story_hooks: The party is in a meeting when the room's mesh connectivity drops — someone nearby has activated an Ironveil, and no one at the table admits to owning one.
A witness the party is protecting disappears; their emergency beacon went silent at a precise moment that correlates with Ironveil field suppression, but the coat was never recovered at the scene.

An Arcturus Defense Solutions internal manifest lists twelve Ironveil units as 'field-destroyed' — but forensic analysis suggests they were resold to a private buyer through a shell procurement company.

A player character acquires an Ironveil only to discover its battery cell has been modified to transmit the field's activation timestamps to an unknown receiver — someone wants to know exactly when and where the coat is being used.

physical_description.visual_profile: A tailored heavy-weave tactical coat with a deceptively civilian appearance—structured shoulders, clean lines, and a fitted silhouette that reads as high-end streetwear rather than military hardware. The coat's exterior betrays no obvious tech integration; the metamaterial suppression system is entirely internal, visible only as subtle geometric quilting patterns running along the interior lining.
physical_description.dimensions: Standard adult jacket; chest width 45–50cm when laid flat, length 65–72cm, sleeve length 60–65cm depending on wearer
physical_description.weight_description: 2.1kg total with battery cell installed. Handheld-weight distributed across shoulders and torso; worn weight is negligible due to balanced load distribution across the coat structure
physical_description.primary_material: Outer shell: reinforced synthetic blend (polymer-cotton hybrid) in matte finish; inner lining: interlocking metamaterial panels (composite resin with embedded resonance tuning elements)
physical_description.finish: Outer fabric has a soft, tactile matte finish with subtle texture—resembles high-grade tactical fabric but reads as premium civilian outerwear. Inner metamaterial lining has a faint iridescent quality visible only in specific light angles, hinting at its technological nature
physical_description.color_scheme: Four colorways: midnight charcoal (primary), urban grey, midnight blue, and matte black. Minimal accent color—subtle reflective piping along seams in dim grey or slate
physical_description.interface_elements: Single tactile pressure switch embedded in left inner cuff (recessed, press-and-hold activation). Small status indicator light (dim blue LED when active, amber during battery swap mode) inside left chest pocket. Battery cell access panel on left interior seam (concealed snap-closure, requires 90-second manual swap). No visible screens or prominent controls
distinctive_features: Geometric quilting pattern on interior lining—organic-looking but precisely structured, hinting at metamaterial lattice beneath
Faint iridescent shimmer visible on metamaterial lining only in certain light angles
Nearly invisible battery cell—sleek cylindrical module no larger than a power bank, integrated into coat's internal pocket structure
Textured inner seam work—metamaterial panels create subtle raised patterns on the inside surface
Concealed activation switch—requires knowing exactly where to press; no obvious controls visible
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: ARCTURUS DEFENSE SOLUTIONS discreet woven label inside left collar (small, professional typeface, no logo decoration). Regulatory compliance stamp and frequency band documentation tucked inside battery compartment
physical_description.condition_typical: In use, appears as an ordinary high-quality tactical or technical wear jacket. When active, no external indicators of function—the 3-meter suppression field is entirely invisible. After 4 hours of continuous operation, a subtle warmth develops in the inner lining due to metamaterial harmonic activity
